title: The World #RunsOnOpenStack
headerText:
Thousands of users around the world run on OpenStack. Discover why organizations adopt OpenStack, what workloads they are running and the impact it has on their overall business.

OpenStack is the open source cloud computing standard to support virtual machines, container and bare metal workloads. Learn more about open source integration options in the Open Infrastructure Blueprint white paper.
heroText: From automotive to healthcare and finance to e-commerce, OpenStack is running critical workloads around the world.
